name: claude-openai-bridge
description: OpenAI-compatible shim over the Claude Code CLI (subscription OAuth) — serves octocode's GraphRAG LLM-extraction pass without a metered API key. Internal sidecar on oci-apps; never public.

native_build.cmd: curl -fsSL https://deb.nodesource.com/setup_22.x | bash - && apt-get install -y --no-install-recommends nodejs && npm install -g @anthropic-ai/claude-code && npm install --omit=dev && useradd -r -m -u 10001 appuser && mkdir -p /home/appuser/.claude && chown -R appuser:appuser /home/appuser
